description: Which brands do ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude actually recommend in a category? The Agent Exchange engine asks every model the real buyer questions and scores every answer. One call returns the ranked leaderboard: each brand's AI-visibility score (0-100), the models that mention it, and the competitors the AI names instead. Use for market research, competitive analysis, lead scoring and brand monitoring. Params: category.
name: get_recommend
